answer: An onyx freight market can stop fake agents harvesting a harbor rebate by demanding collateral for each claim. Reserve it until an independently assigned inspector can check the cargo; a random audit exposes false claims and confiscates their bonds. No bond may secure two pending claims, even under different keys. If the audit rate is p, bond B and maximum rebate R, require pB > R. Every added fake claim then loses money on average and immobilizes capital. The signal must come from independent inspection, since signatures from cooperating aliases prove little.
